key_terms.الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ: Hasan and Husayn (the sons of Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: Did Imam Ali show favoritism to his sons Hasan and Husayn in matters of justice?
ai.summary: This famous declaration by Imam Ali (AS) underscores the principle of 'Adl (justice) over 'Urf (customary favoritism), illustrating that his authority was rooted in divine law rather than tribal or familial loyalty. By asserting that he would punish his own sons if they erred, he validated the legitimacy of his rule during a period of political fragmentation, setting a precedent for impartial governance in Shia political thought. This incident is often cited to demonstrate the consistency of the Ahl al-Bayt in applying the same standards to themselves as they demanded of others.

en.sayed-ali-raza: even if Ḥasan and Ḥusayn had done what you did there would have been no leniency with me for them and they could not have won their way with me till I had recovered from them the right and destroyed the wrong produced by their unjust action.
